initialize_ConfigParser: initialize a ConfigParser from argparse and a JSON config file to manage experiment directories and settings
call_ConfigParser_initialize: call ConfigParser.initialize to dynamically instantiate a module class using config-defined type and args
get_ConfigParser_logger: get a configured logger from ConfigParser with a specified verbosity level of 0, 1, or 2
access_ConfigParser_config: access the parsed config dictionary via ConfigParser config property or bracket notation
update_config_helper: use _update_config to merge CLI option values into a nested config dictionary by target path
